title: Viola Configuration
description: Configuration schema for viola convention linter in deno.json

issueCategory.description: Category of an issue - what kind of problem it represents

issueImpact.description: Impact level of an issue - how urgent it is (critical > major > minor > trivial)

minConfidence.description: Minimum confidence score (0-100) required to report the issue

patternValue.description: Severity or configuration object for a pattern

items.description: Import specifier for a linter plugin module

plugins.description: List of plugin modules to load. Uses the same syntax as TypeScript/Deno imports: import map references (e.g., '@hiisi/viola-linters'), JSR specifiers (e.g., 'jsr:@scope/package'), npm specifiers (e.g., 'npm:package'), or URLs.

scopeConfig.description: Issue patterns mapped to severities. Keys are pattern strings matching linter/issue identifiers.

propertyNames.description: Pattern syntax: 'linter/issue' (exact), 'linter/*' (all from linter), '*::category' (by category), '*>=impact' (by impact threshold), or combinations
